content.text: I built the vote-by-mail flyer and rendered all three sizes with no layout defects: [portrait](/var/folders/hf/35wnqrnj2bbb1_llbg87zlt40000gn/T/scene-mcp-e2e-llm-90739/renders/s77b06d1829/portrait-v7.png), [wide](/var/folders/hf/35wnqrnj2bbb1_llbg87zlt40000gn/T/scene-mcp-e2e-llm-90739/renders/s77b06d1829/wide-v7.png) and [sky](/var/folders/hf/35wnqrnj2bbb1_llbg87zlt40000gn/T/scene-mcp-e2e-llm-90739/renders/s77b06d1829/sky-v7.png). I moved the crop down to show more of the scene, but I didn't preview that last change. At the sky size, text was only about 7px, so I enlarged it there and rearranged that size's layout; its footer is 11px.
